  "phoneNote": "The distinctive automotive styling works, but the opening photo mostly shows workshop floor and delays the oversized headline too far down the screen.",
  "desktopNote": "The workshop hero and number-plate call button feel business-specific, but oversized typography dominates the page and breaks “ZAMENJAMO” mid-word in the tyre section.",

  },

    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Shorten the mobile photo area and reposition its crop around the raised car and lift rather than the floor, bringing the service headline higher into the first screen.",
    "Reduce headline sizes responsively, especially in the desktop tyre section, and prevent mid-word wrapping so headings fit their columns naturally.",
    "Remove the empty space beneath the mobile hero’s call caption and consolidate the repeated tyre prices into either the pricing section or the tyre feature."
  ]
}
